### 2. Making the Changes

<!-- Detailed steps on HOW to implement this. -->

```bash
# Clone and setup
git clone https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/midori-desktop.git
cd midori-desktop
./mach bootstrap
./mach build
```

**Changes to make:**
1. Open `path/to/file.js`
2. Find the function called `functionName()`
3. Modify it to do X instead of Y

**Code example:**
```javascript
// Before:
function oldFunction() {
  return x + y;
}

// After:
function newFunction() {
  return x + y + z;  // Now includes z!
}
```

### 3. Testing Your Changes

```bash
# Run specific test
./mach test tests/unit/MyTest.cpp

# Or run the browser
./mach run
# Test manually: [Steps to verify manually]
```
